answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 60 POA, slashed in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 12 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 60 POA on a stranger, so a farm needs 940 bought sponsors, each risking real money. What carries the tide here is verification, the whisper of cost is what stops the farm, and the trellis of the record keeps every claim checkable.
